description.zh:
是否使用公网地址暴露API Server，取值

- true 使用公网API Server
- false 使用内网API Server
description.en:
Specifies whether to expose the API server to the Internet. Valid values:

*   true: exposes the API server to the Internet.
*   false: exposes the API server to the internal network.

description.zh:
是否启用工作流集群UI。仅当Profile为XFlow的时候生效。取值：

true：启用。
false：禁用。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable the workflow instance UI. This parameter takes effect only if Profile is set to XFlow. Valid values:

*   true
*   false

description.zh:
是否开启审计日志。取值
- true：开启。
- false：关闭。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable the audit log feature. Valid values:

*   true: enables the audit log feature.
*   false: disables the audit log feature.
Specifies whether to use an advanced security group.
The name of the master instance.

description.zh: 工作流负载价格限制。WorkflowScheduleMode取值为cost-optimized时生效。
description.en: The limit on the prices of containers in the workflow. This parameter takes effect only if the WorkflowScheduleMode parameter is set to cost-optimized.

description.zh:
舰队Fleet实例配置信息。取值：

- `Default`：标准场景舰队Fleet实例。
- `XFlow`：工作流场景舰队Fleet实例。

默认值：`Default`。
description.en:
The type of scenario for which the master instance is suitable. Valid values:

*   `Default`: The master instance is suitable for standard scenarios.
*   `XFlow`: The master instance is suitable for workflow scenarios.

Default value: `Default`.

description.zh: 地域ID。说明您可以通过DescribeRegions接口查看可用地域。
description.en: The ID of the region. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query available regions.

description.zh:
标签信息。

一次最多支持输入20个标签信息。
description.en:
The tags.

You can specify at most 20 tags in each call.

description.zh: 集群所属的VPC ID。您可以调用DescribeVpcs查询已创建的VPC信息。
description.en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) to which the master instance belongs. You can call the DescribeVpcs operation to query available VPCs.

description.zh:
工作流调度模式。仅当Profile为XFlow的时候生效。取值
- cost-optimized：成本优先
- stock-optimized：库存优先
description.en:
The scheduling mode of the workflow. This parameter takes effect only if Profile is set to XFlow. Valid values:

*   cost-optimized: cost-prioritized scheduling mode.
*   stock-optimized: inventory-prioritized scheduling mode.
